verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API for use in your own case management system. Supporting this are case decisions (no risk / risk accepted / offboard), a case audit-trail endpoint, case exports, external-identifier customer lookup, idempotent webhooks and an OpenAPI schema covering case and audit resources. Missing for 10: a documented webhook event for case or decision changes (only WORKFLOW_COMPLETED is shown), an explicit endpoint for writing a case decision, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of two-way sync.
